functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.activity_artifact_content_path(target_profile_id uuid, target_digest text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select 'artifacts/sha256/'||target_profile_id::text||'/'||target_digest
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.activity_parent_segment_set_constraint_trigger()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  perform public.validate_activity_segment_set(new.id);
  return null;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.activity_segment_set_constraint_trigger()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  perform public.validate_activity_segment_set(coalesce(new.activity_id, old.activity_id));
  return null;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.block_activity_artifact_direct_delete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if old.availability<>'deleted'
    or current_setting('gradientpeak.artifact_hard_delete_authorized',true) is distinct from 'on' then
    raise exception 'activity artifact delete requires completed service lifecycle';
  end if;
  return old;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.purge_deleted_activity_artifact(target_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  perform set_config('gradientpeak.artifact_hard_delete_authorized','on',true);
  delete from public.activity_artifacts where id=target_id and availability='deleted';
  if not found then raise exception 'artifact tombstone is not deletable'; end if;
end $function$
